title: Mouse Without Border, can not enable Service

issue_context.summary: The elevated per-machine service-mode failure needs the actual toggle/transition result and corresponding trace.
inferences: Signer rejection could prevent the mode transition, but a disabled control and a failed service restart need different remediation.
known_information: The reporter supplies0.102.3001, Windows build26300, elevated status and per-machine scope; these facts must not be requested again.
The report says service mode cannot be enabled but does not state whether the control is disabled, reverts, or shows a transition error; no archive is supplied.
Current UseService guards configured policy and an in-progress transition. ChangeServiceModeAsync then awaits shutdown, changes the persisted mode and waits for the restarted verified endpoint.
The separate failure boundaries include policy gating, shutdown, restarted endpoint availability and identity verification; no one boundary is established by the current report.
Merged51789 covers signer verification, not every service-install/start or policy condition.

comment.body:
The report already establishes an elevated, per-machine 0.102.3001 installation, so repeating an administrator/install-scope checklist would not help. Service mode crosses a shutdown/restart and verified Settings IPC boundary; the current description does not show whether the toggle is unavailable or the transition fails after clicking it.

- Please tell us whether **Use Service** is greyed out, changes and reverts, or reports an error, and include the displayed error text.
- Comment `/bugreport` immediately after one attempt so the report captures the service/Settings IPC transition. Do not post the pairing/security key.

#51789 has merged for a known signer rejection, but that is only a possible cause here; it does not repair a policy-disabled toggle or prove a service-start failure is the same defect.
